# S-10 — Django release process and LTS (fixture reading note)
accessed: 2026-09-18 · tier: T3 (vendor documentation) · depth: full

## Findings
- Django publishes explicit long-term-support releases every two years, each supported for
  three years — the widest support window of the three candidates.
- Licence: BSD-3-Clause (SPDX-listed).
